title: Florae and Fauni
heading: Florae and Fauni
summary: Airy Spirits attached to individual plants and animals, with typical Magic Might range and powers for designing them.
quotes: Most fauni and florae possess Cunning rather than Intelligence.

title: Spirits of the Elements
heading: Spirits of the Elements
summary: Airy Spirits tied to individual non-living natural objects, with Might scaling by the object's size and importance and differing outlooks by elemental Form.
quotes: A spirit of an element can be present in any matter that is still in its natural form

title: Imagines, Spirits of Sensation
heading: Imagines, the Spirits of Sensation
summary: Airy Spirits embodying sensory species, with Imaginem Might and powers that replicate effects matching their sensation.
quotes: The weakest of these spirits represents a specific incidence of a species, whereas those of Might 10 or more represent more-general qualities.

title: Eidolons, Spirits of Emotions
heading: Eidolons, the Spirits of Emotions
summary: Spirits of emotion created by humans in contact with strong magic; their Might derives from Personality Flaws or Traits and they can be summoned through an Arcane Connection to a person feeling the emotion.
quotes: Otherwise, the spirit has a Might equal to (5 x Personality Trait).

title: Spell Spirits
heading: Spell Spirits
summary: Theurgists can summon spirits whose only power duplicates a specific spell or Form; the summoning duration sets how long the spirit attends.
quotes: A spell spirit has a Might at least equal to the level of the spell

title: Spirits of Place, Genii Loci
heading: Spirits of Place, Genii Loci
summary: The most powerful Airy Spirits, bound to a locus (a place) rather than an object, with typical powers and a protective relationship to everything in the locus.
quotes: Further, all genii loci possess the Ways of the (Land) Virtue.

title: Jinn
heading: Jinn
requires: Being type: Jinn (Magic, Faerie or Infernal)
summary: A variety of genii loci from desert lands that can align to Magic, Faerie or Infernal Realms, share a bargain-binding Malediction, and can temporarily transfer their locus.
quotes: it is bound to the agreed terms unless its partner reneges first

title: Lugra, Spirits of Hardship
heading: Lugra, Spirits of Hardship
summary: Parasitic spirits of life's hardships that afflict randomly chosen hosts, with typical Control Human and Mastery powers.

title: The Named Spirits (Daimons and Aspects)
heading: The Named Spirits
summary: Daimons draw power from True Names and act in the world through Aspects, each of which is built as its own spirit with separate statistics.
quotes: Each Aspect of a Daimon should be created as if it were an independent spirit.

title: Spirits and Hermetic Magic
heading: Spirits and Hermetic Magic
summary: How Hermetic magi summon and control Airy Spirits with Rego, and the extra requirements for summoning a Daimon's Aspect, with theurgist advantages.
quotes: the spell of the non-theurgist must have a base level equal to twice the Daimon's Might
related: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Chapters 4, 8 and 9

title: Arcane Connections, True Names, and Synthemata (Spirits)
heading: Arcane Connections, True Names, and Synthemata
summary: What counts as an Arcane Connection to a spirit or Daimon, how True Names are learned as spell-like abilities with experience points, and how synthemata and True Names help with spirit magic.
quotes: costs 5 experience points to learn
Knowing the True Name of a creature adds 5 to all lab totals to research synthemata for that same being.

title: Spirits and Non-Hermetic Magic (Goetic Arts)
heading: Spirits and Non-Hermetic Magic
summary: Summary of the four Goetic Arts used by non-Hermetic sorcerers to summon, drain, bind and command spirits, and which Realms each is aligned to.
quotes: There are four Goetic Arts — namely Summoning, Ablating, Binding, and Commanding
related: Realms of Power: The Infernal, Chapter 11: Ars Goetia

title: New Spirit Spells and Spell Guidelines
heading: New Spirit Spells and Spell Guidelines
summary: General rule that spells to summon, perceive or control spirits must penetrate the spirit's Magic Might, with notes on controlling a Daimon's Aspect.
quotes: All spells to summon, perceive, or control a spirit must penetrate its Magic Might.

title: Intellego (Form) Spirit Guidelines
heading: Intellego (Form)
summary: Intellego guidelines for sensing supernatural creatures whose Might is aligned to a Form, graded by minimum Might.
quotes: Sense a supernatural creature of Might 30 or above with a Might associated with the Form.

title: Rego (Form) Spirit Guidelines
heading: Rego (Form)
summary: Rego guidelines for controlling and summoning Airy Spirits tied to a Form; an Arcane Connection is always needed to summon.
quotes: Control an Airy Spirit of (Form).
Summon an Airy Spirit of (Form).

title: Rego Vim Spirit Guidelines
heading: Rego Vim
summary: Rego Vim guidelines for controlling or summoning Airy Spirits of a Realm, and a general guideline for summoning a Daimon's Aspect as a Ritual.
quotes: Summon an Aspect of a Daimon if (level + 4 magnitudes) equals or exceeds twice its Might. (Ritual)

title: Characters Touched by Spirits of Place
heading: Example Spirits of Places
summary: Ways characters can gain powers from long exposure to a genius loci: birth Virtues and Flaws, Grant powers, possession, bargains and pacts, communion for Mystery initiation, and Warping.
quotes: Major bargains may constitute a pact (granting the Spiritual Pact Virtue)

title: Ghosts (Apparitions, Shades, Spectres)
heading: Ghosts
summary: Describes the kinds of Magical ghost (apparitions, shades and spectres), how each remembers its life, what ties it to the world and how it can be laid to rest.
related: Realms of Power: The Infernal, page 36

title: Ghosts as Characters
heading: Ghosts as Characters
summary: Ghosts are built as spirits with the Magic Spirit Virtue, and the ability to take material form is treated as a supernatural power that not every ghost has.
quotes: are spirits with no true material form and must have the Magic Spirit special Virtue

title: Designing a Ghost: Concept
heading: Concept
summary: Steps for building a ghost: choose a Flaw as its worldly tie, generate Characteristics as for a human, give it Magic Spirit and a Magical Social Status, and drop Virtues and Flaws that no longer apply.
quotes: All ghosts should have the special Virtue, Magic Spirit

title: Designing a Ghost: Season and Abilities
heading: Season and Abilities
summary: Guidance on which character Season to use for apparitions, shades and spectres according to how much of their living knowledge they retain.
quotes: should usually be designed as Autumn characters.

title: Extraordinary Vis
heading: Extraordinary Vis
requires: Extraordinary vis found in powerful magical places
summary: Rules for vis that carries a special power: how it is detected, investigated in the lab, and the limits on its effects, Range and pawn count.
quotes: A reasonable guideline is 1 pawn per 10 levels of the magical effect produced by the extraordinary vis.
the Laboratory Total to discover the vis' power and triggering event is equal to half the spell level of the spell-like vis.

title: Lesser Enchantment Vis
heading: Lesser Enchantment Vis
requires: Extraordinary vis of the lesser enchantment type
summary: Extraordinary vis that emulates a lesser enchantment, designed like a normal lesser enchantment but free of the usual material and size limits; moving it to another object destroys its power.
quotes: This form of extraordinary vis emulates a lesser enchantment, usually level 30 or lower.

title: Spell-like Vis
heading: Spell-like Vis
requires: Extraordinary vis of the spell-like type
summary: Extraordinary vis that mimics a high-level spell once, needs a triggering event, and is completely consumed by its effect.
quotes: Unlike lesser enchantment vis, spell-like vis cannot produce a continuous magical effect and is completely consumed at the end of the effect.

title: Dedicated Vis
heading: Dedicated Vis
requires: Dedicated vis (a specific Technique and Form pairing)
summary: Rare vis tied to a Technique and Form combination that counts as two pawns and gives bonuses in spell use, study and enchantment creation when used for that combination.
quotes: the vis may not be disaggregated into separate pawns of vis

title: Dedicated Vis in Spell Use
heading: Spell Use
requires: Dedicated vis (a specific Technique and Form pairing)
summary: Dedicated vis used to power a spell, Ritual or enchantment of its own Technique and Form is twice as effective, including for botch dice.
quotes: a magus using dedicated vis enjoys a vis boost of +4 per pawn used

title: Studying Dedicated Vis
heading: Study
requires: Dedicated vis (a specific Technique and Form pairing)
summary: How a magus studies from dedicated vis: each pawn counts double toward the minimum needed, Source Quality is halved, and botch dice are doubled; dedicated and normal vis can be mixed to study two Arts at once.
quotes: The Source Quality is determined as normal and the total is divided by 2.

title: Dedicated Vis in Enchantment Creation
heading: Enchantment Creation
requires: Dedicated vis (a specific Technique and Form pairing)
summary: Dedicated vis grants double shape and material bonuses and counts as already-opened vis for enchanting the object it is in.
quotes: it gives double the normal shape and material bonus
related: The Mysteries Revised Edition, Ready-Opened Devices, page 41

title: Vis Storage
heading: Vis Storage
summary: Optional rule that large stockpiles of single-Art vis cause spontaneous Art-appropriate spells, with the spell magnitude growing with each multiple of the minimum stored, plus a simpler list of harmless effects per Art.
quotes: For every multiple beyond the minimum, an additional magnitude is added to the level of spells that may spontaneously occur.

title: Extraordinary and Dedicated Vis Costs (Covenant Creation)
heading: Covenant Creation Costs
summary: Build Point costs for covenant vis sources that produce extraordinary or dedicated vis, and how those costs set trade value relative to normal vis.
quotes: Dedicated Vis Source Cost: 7.5 Build Points per pawn of vis per year
divide its cost in Build Points by 5

title: Insubstantial Vis
heading: Insubstantial Vis
summary: Special vis moved out of its native form loses its powers, so insubstantial vis (wind, scent, sound, light) must be kept in sealed vials or enchanted containers.
quotes: Transferring special, dedicated, or unique vis from its native form to another shape destroys the special powers contained in the vis.

title: Enriching a Thing of Virtue
heading: Enriching a Thing of Virtue
summary: Procedure for Enriching Herbs and Objects of Virtue with a season of magical operation to grant a Virtue to the wearer, including the Magic Lore roll to learn the method, the Enrichment Total, the Virtues conferred, drawbacks and Warping.
quotes: make an Intelligence + Magic Lore roll against an Ease Factor of 9
Enrichment Total: Intelligence + Magic Lore + aura
related: ArM5 p.184 Penetration of Supernatural Abilities

title: Hedge Magicians and Enriched Things of Virtue
heading: Hedge Magicians and Enriched Things of Virtue
summary: How ungifted hedge magicians use Enriched Things of Virtue to gain minor powers at the cost of accumulating Warping.
quotes: The mechanics of Enriching a Thing of Virtue allow an unGifted character to acquire minor magical powers.

title: Hermetic Magi and Enriched Things of Virtue
heading: Hermetic Magi and Enriched Things of Virtue
summary: Why magi rarely benefit from Enriched Things of Virtue and how one can be built into an invested item or talisman.
quotes: An invested item made from an Enriched Thing of Virtue can only be made into a talisman if the magus Enriched the item himself.

title: Shape and Material Bonuses for Herbs of Virtue
heading: Shape and Material Bonuses for Herbs of Virtue
summary: List of the shape and material bonuses that each example Herb of Virtue provides to enchantments.
quotes: +7 divination

title: Objects of Virtue
heading: Objects of Virtue
summary: Objects of Virtue derive their Virtues from the same Shape and Material Bonuses magi use, and any vis-bearing item with such a bonus to an Art can be Enriched to confer Puissant Art.
quotes: can be Enriched to confer Puissant Art

title: Shape and Material Bonuses for Objects of Virtue
heading: Shape and Material Bonuses for Objects of Virtue
summary: List of the shape and material bonuses that each example Formed Stone or Object of Virtue provides to enchantments.
quotes: +2 arthritis

title: Awakened Trees
heading: Awakened Trees
summary: Trees in Magic auras are awake, with wakefulness rising with aura strength, and have Cunning instead of Intelligence and no Might score.
quotes: In an aura of level 6 or higher, the trees are fully awake and can see and hear about as well as a human can.
related: ArM5 p.137 Stir the Slumbering Tree

title: Animated Trees
heading: Animated Trees
requires: Trees animated by spell or spirit
summary: How trees become mobile through spells or spirit powers, and when an animated tree has a Might score.
quotes: temporarily gains Might equal to the activation cost of the power

title: Character Guide: An Animated Tree
heading: Character Guide: An Animated Tree
requires: Trees animated by spell or spirit
summary: Stock statistics block to use for any animated tree, with guidance on uprooting and moving it via Manifestation.
quotes: Under most circumstances, an animate tree has no Might score.
related: ArM5 p.139 Lord of the Trees

title: Option: Brawl Skill for Animated Trees
heading: Option: Brawl Skill for Animated Trees
requires: Trees animated by spell or spirit
summary: Optional rule giving each animated tree its own Brawl skill, set by the caster's Finesse or by the animating spirit.
quotes: a tree animated by a spell has a Brawl skill equal to the caster's Finesse

title: Trees of Virtue
heading: Trees of Virtue
summary: Trees of Virtue hold 1 to 3 pawns of vis tied to their powers and can be Enriched using only part of the tree, which depletes the tree's magic.
quotes: Enriching this item, or collecting the tree's vis, depletes the tree's magical powers.

title: Elementals and Rarefication
heading: Elementals
summary: What elementals are and how pure raw elemental matter rarefies into one, including spontaneous rarefication from Warped matter.
quotes: raw elemental matter possessing a Warping Score of 5 may spontaneously rarefy into an elemental

title: Magic and Elementals
heading: Magic and Elementals
summary: How magi create, control and destroy elementals with Creo, Rego and Perdo, and how botches or purification magic in a Magic aura can accidentally rarefy one.
quotes: The production of an elemental is a potential consequence of any botched spell or lab activity involving an elemental Form while in a Magic aura.

title: New Elementals Spells and Spell Guidelines
heading: New Elementals Spells and Spell Guidelines
summary: Spell guidelines for creating, converting, controlling and destroying elementals using the elemental Forms.
quotes: Create an elemental from a base amount of elemental matter (Ritual)
Completely control an elemental

title: Designing Elementals
heading: Designing Elementals
summary: Introduction to building an elemental character as a Magic Thing, with its inherited Virtues and Flaws.
quotes: the general principles can be applied to use an elemental as the starting point for a magic character

title: Elemental Concept and Characteristics
heading: Concept
summary: How an elemental's Size and element determine its Characteristics, which Characteristics cannot be negative for each element, and the Size adjustment applied to Quickness and Strength.
quotes: make the usual adjustment from Size, subtracting Size from Quickness and adding twice Size to Strength.

title: Elemental Season and Abilities
heading: Season and Abilities
summary: Elementals are normally Spring characters and must buy Brawl and Athletics (or Swim for water) to a score tied to their Might, using Improved Abilities if experience runs short.
quotes: Elementals are almost always Spring characters

title: Elemental Might and Qualities
heading: Might and Qualities
summary: Elemental Might is set by the amount of matter it formed from and fixes its Size, with fixed free Qualities and an obligatory Greater Power for its element.
quotes: Every increase in magnitude of Might (as if it were a spell) adds three to the Size.

title: Elemental Combat
heading: Elemental Combat
summary: Wounds taken by an elemental also drain its Might Pool, reaching zero leaves it inanimate, and broken-off matter holds recoverable vis.
quotes: each wound also reduces the elemental's Might Pool by a number of points equal to the Wound Penalty

title: Elemental Powers
heading: Elemental Powers
summary: Every elemental has a power from its matter and one for its natural attack; the attack ignores Magic Resistance cost-free but Magic Resistance can still block touching.

title: Size, Might, and Characteristics of Elementals
heading: Size, Might, and Characteristics of Elementals
summary: Table giving the Size and the eight typical Characteristic values for elementals at each Might score, with no point cost.
quotes: Like other Magic Things (see Chapter 3: Magic Characters), the Size of an elemental is dependent on the Might chosen for it

title: Earth Elementals
heading: Earth Elementals
summary: Description of earth elementals (genomi): what they rarefy from, how Size relates to raw material, how they move and attack and which weapons harm them.
quotes: Only bludgeoning weapons such as hammers, maces, or axes can damage an earth elemental

title: Water Elementals
heading: Water Elementals
summary: Description of water elementals (lymphae): what they rarefy from, Size scale, movement, and how weapons, fire and Scuffle damage affect them.
quotes: A water elemental's attacks only inflict Scuffle damage

title: Air Elementals
heading: Air Elementals
summary: Description of air elementals (zephyri): what forms them, Size scale, movement, immunity to weapons, and that they have no natural attack and rely on powers.
quotes: Weapons are meaningless to a creature with this power, they simply pass straight through.

title: Fire Elementals
heading: Fire Elementals
summary: Description of fire elementals (phlegethi): what they rarefy from, Size scale, movement over flammable surfaces, and how weapons and water affect them.
quotes: It may also jump a gap of non-flammable surface (such as bare rock) up to a width equal to its Magic Might in feet.

title: Beast Statistics
heading: Beast Statistics
summary: Rules for mundane beast statistics: Characteristics outside the human range need no Virtue, Cunning replaces Intelligence, beasts cannot learn new Abilities without training, and they have no Might or vis.
quotes: Beasts do not need a Virtue or Flaw to have Characteristics outside the normal human range of –3 to +3.

title: Modifying Beast Sizes
heading: Modifying Beast Sizes
summary: How to change a beast's Size by adjusting Strength and Quickness per point of Size, then updating combat statistics.
quotes: add 2 points of Strength and subtract one point of Quickness for each point of Size added

title: Beast Virtues, Flaws, and Qualities
heading: Beast Virtues, Flaws, and Qualities
summary: Species Virtues and Flaws are free to all members and guide designing a species, while exceptional individuals may take balanced individual Virtues and Flaws, and Qualities adjust capabilities.
quotes: It is recommended that a species have at least one point of Flaws for every three points of Virtues.
related: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults, pages 40-43

title: New Virtues for Beasts (Ferocity)
heading: New Virtues for Beasts
summary: Beasts with Ferocity get a pool of Confidence points usable only when their natural ferocity is triggered, such as defending a den or fighting a natural enemy.
quotes: take three points for you to use when those circumstances are met

title: Beasts in Combat
heading: Beasts in Combat
summary: Beasts use most human combat options, can use Confidence if they have Ferocity, and attack with only one natural weapon per round.
quotes: Regardless of how many weapons a beast has, it may only attack with one weapon in a given round.
